conclusions: Concurrent resident GUI and native camera hit an actual system OOM with no swap; GUI anonymous RSS alone was about23MiB
Remaining file-cache/decompression pressure can explain latency before OOM, but exact UI deadline contribution remains separately testable
Native all-ISP continuous20sec capture is stable once GUI RSS is absent
Do not classify B as concurrent success or C as a paused-GUI comparison
At OOM file LRU had only60KiB left and normalfree exactly minimum856KiB; reclaimable file pages were exhausted while34,508KiB remained on anonymous LRU
limits: No paused-resident-GUI comparison survived: GUI was already OOM-killed
No native or Python runtime source changes made by this isolation harness
No conclusion that memory is the only possible cause of every active-UI deadline failure
